method: Each of the 19 Opus-5.5 family rows in OPUS_5_5_CAPABILITY_OWNERSHIP_MATRIX_V1.json is classified by its quoted best route: if an external model or external service is in the route, the family is not a Brain capability under the law regardless of its matrix status. Model-free components named by the routes are listed separately with their measurement state. Nothing in the matrix, the predicate registry or any pointer is modified by this audit.

classification_legend.MEASURED_PASS: has a TRUE_CAPABILITY_RECEIPT_V1 with verdict PASS in the ledger (sandbox or public runner as stated)
classification_legend.MEASURED_FAIL: has a receipt with verdict FAIL
classification_legend.COMPONENT_MEASURED_PASS: a family whose route contains at least one MEASURED_PASS component; the family itself is not thereby owned
classification_legend.MEASURABLE_PENDING: model-free; an independent oracle class is identified; no receipt yet
classification_legend.MEASURABLE_PENDING_NEEDS_CADQUERY: as above but the solver needs a dependency unavailable in the sandbox
classification_legend.EXTERNAL_MODEL_ROUTE: route depends on an external model; not eligible as a Brain capability
classification_legend.EXTERNAL_MODEL_ROUTE_WITH_MEASURABLE_COM: as above, but names model-free components that can be measured on their own
classification_legend.EXTERNAL_LIBRARY_IS_THE_CAPABILITY: the solver is an un-vendored third-party library or service; eligible only if a Brain layer adds something measurable
classification_legend.CHECKER_GAMING: passes a checker by output shape; not eligible

what_this_audit_does_not_say: It does not say any family is owned, does not change any matrix status, predicate, scoreboard or pointer, and credits nothing. A MEASURED_PASS component is exactly what its receipt says.
